programs.title: Thomas & Friends: All Engines Go!
programs.desc: When Percy has to deliver a new lightbulb to the lighthouse at night, Thomas suggests playing secret agents along the way to help Percy forget about his fear of the dark.

programs.title: Play School: Let's Take A Ride
programs.desc: What will the Play School Get-Set-Go Mobile be today? Whoosh, a plane! Michelle & Alex take a ride up in the air and visit the Annual Aussie Animal Air Show with the toys. Humpty makes his way through the airport.

programs.title: Fireman Sam
programs.sub_title: Magic Mandini and the Great Normanski
programs.desc: Norman practices his magic act for the talent show, but it turns out that his assistant Mandy is better at magic than he is. But when he tries to make her disappear, he accidentally causes a fire. Meanwhile, Radar turns out to be quite the diva….

programs.title: Knee High Spies
programs.desc: Mum has set up the playroom as a puzzle room for the kids, but when Pranksy locks the door, the spies must play all the puzzles to escape.

programs.title: Stan Can
programs.desc: The school are creating a dinosaur to put on display at the museum. Sophie is the dinosaur expert so knows exactly what to do, but when the spectacular dinosaur is finished it's too big to move. Stanley has an idea!

programs.title: Nikhil & Jay
programs.sub_title: Nikhil and Jay and the Rock Band
programs.desc: Nikhil and Jay start their own rock band! But Nikhil is deflated when Jay keeps inviting other people to join the band. Nikhil wants it to be just the two of them.
